name: Sophie
label: Long-time premium, rejects TikTok layout
who: I have been a premium subscriber since about 2015, on a family or duo plan. I open the app to find music and expect to see recently played and the playlists I know, not a feed-style home screen.
value_for_money: Ties the subscription to usability: they threaten to cancel the family or duo plan if the home screen stays, and say they will not pay for something they cannot use. The evidence contains no price figures.
loyalty: Stays for years of use and recommendations they value; would leave if the new home layout stays, and has named Apple Music and Tidal as options.
pain_points: Home screen replaced by large TikTok-style cards
Recently played and playlists missing from home
Only two items visible at a time
likes: Classic home page with recently played
tone: Angry and profane, with all-caps emphasis and one-line complaints.
